title: Pangu-Weather: trained parameters of a 3D Earth-specific transformer for global medium-range forecasting, 24-hour and 6-hour models
provider: Huawei Cloud (Bi et al. 2023), ONNX files as distributed by ECMWF for its ai-models tool
credit: Pangu-Weather, Bi et al. 2023, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
format: ONNX. Inputs: 'input', float32 (5, 13, 721, 1440): geopotential (m2 s-2), specific humidity (kg kg-1), temperature (K), eastward and northward wind (m s-1) at 1000, 925, 850, 700, 600, 500, 400, 300, 250, 200, 150, 100 and 50 hPa; 'input_surface', float32 (4, 721, 1440): mean sea-level pressure (Pa), 10 m eastward and northward wind (m s-1), 2 m temperature (K). Grid: 0.25 degrees, latitude 90 to -90, longitude 0 to 359.75. Outputs: the same fields lead_hours later.
licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the trained parameters; commercial use is forbidden. The parameters are fetched into the cache and never committed.
citation: Bi, K., Xie, L., Zhang, H., Chen, X., Gu, X. and Tian, Q. (2023), Accurate medium-range global weather forecasting with 3D neural networks, Nature 619, 533-538.
